Kimodo_cower.prompt: A person in fear crouches down and covers their head with both arms.

Kimodo_getup_back.prompt: A person lying flat on their back on the ground gets up to a standing position.

Kimodo_getup_front.prompt: A person lying face down on the ground pushes up with both arms and gets up to a standing position.

Kimodo_getup_hurt.prompt: A person lying on their back slowly and painfully gets up, holding their stomach with one hand.

Kimodo_hit_back.prompt: A person is hit hard in the back and flinches forward, arching the back in pain.

Kimodo_hit_left.prompt: A person is hit on the left side of the body and recoils to the right.

Kimodo_hit_right.prompt: A person is hit on the right side of the body and recoils to the left.

Kimodo_hit_stomach.prompt: A person is punched in the stomach, doubles over in pain and then straightens up.

Kimodo_injured_walk.prompt: A person walks forward slowly, limping on the left leg and holding their side in pain.

Kimodo_look_around.prompt: A person stands still and looks around curiously, turning the head left and right.

Kimodo_out_of_breath.prompt: A person stands bent over with hands on knees, breathing heavily after running.

Kimodo_panic_run.prompt: A person runs forward in panic, waving the arms and looking back over the shoulder.

Kimodo_phone_talk.prompt: A person stands talking on a phone held to the right ear, gesturing with the left hand.

Kimodo_point_shout.prompt: A person points ahead with the right arm and shouts angrily.

Kimodo_saluto.prompt: a person waves hello with the right hand

Kimodo_stretch.prompt: A person stands and stretches both arms high above the head, then relaxes.

Kimodo_stumble_back.prompt: A person is shoved hard in the chest, stumbles backward a few steps and regains balance.

Kimodo_stumble_forward.prompt: A person is pushed from behind, stumbles forward a few steps and catches their balance.

Kimodo_stumble_left.prompt: A person is shoved from the right side, stumbles sideways to the left and recovers their balance.

Kimodo_stumble_right.prompt: A person is shoved from the left side, stumbles sideways to the right and recovers their balance.

Kimodo_victory.prompt: A person celebrates a victory, jumping and raising both fists in the air.

Kimodo_victory_dance.prompt: A person does a short joyful victory dance, pumping their fists.

Kimodo_wait_impatient.prompt: A person stands waiting impatiently, shifting weight from foot to foot and checking the watch on the left wrist.
